purpose: Run one supplemental external confirmation of the frozen target-fitted 37-feature FRC sufficiency and abstention protocol on QASC without reopening any failed post-hoc method line.

registration_boundary.note: Public schema inspection was used only to define a deterministic adapter. No QASC model output or confirmation metric was available when this protocol was written.

eligibility: aligned choice text and label arrays with answerKey present
non-empty distinct normalized fact1 and fact2
frozen_source.sampling: all eligible validation rows sorted by id; no outcome-dependent sampling

frozen_controlled_candidate_pool.scope: controlled evidence-pool selection, not the original 17M-sentence open-corpus QASC retrieval task
frozen_controlled_candidate_pool.fact_corpus: case-folded whitespace-normalized union of validation fact1 and fact2, preserving first display text and sorting global ids by SHA-256
frozen_controlled_candidate_pool.query: formatted_question containing the question and all answer choices; answerKey and correct answer are not used
frozen_controlled_candidate_pool.gold_candidates: the two official distinct facts, included for controlled selection evaluation
frozen_controlled_candidate_pool.hard_distractors: top 38 non-gold validation facts by deterministic BM25 over formatted_question

bm25.tokenizer: lowercase ASCII alphanumeric tokens with internal apostrophes

frozen_controlled_candidate_pool.question_type: first interrogative token mapped to what/which/how/where/when/why/who/other
limitations: Gold facts are forced into each controlled candidate pool.
Results measure evidence selection and sufficiency behavior, not full-corpus retrieval recall.
Validation facts may recur across cases and are deduplicated by normalized text.

frozen_real_model_scoring.gold_blind_boundary: answer, gold_evidence_ids, candidate.gold and candidate.gold_roles are removed before the scorer call and restored only after scores are returned

frozen_confirmation_protocol.model: 37 observable features, standardized target train only, logistic regression L2=4
frozen_confirmation_protocol.split: 10 pre-registered SHA-256 case-family assignments, each 40% train, 30% calibration and 30% evaluation
frozen_confirmation_protocol.missing_evidence: deterministic synthetic removal from the frozen scored candidates
frozen_confirmation_protocol.review_ranking_policy: Keep the baseline 37-feature review order. Do not evaluate or revive the failed 64-feature review-ranker candidate on QASC.

pre_registered_confirmation_checks.partial_confirmation: 10 of 10 safety reduction passes but at least one absolute-risk check fails

decision_boundary.if_full_confirmation: Report supplemental protocol transfer evidence only; retain NO-GO/SHADOW and require flood-domain expert validation.
decision_boundary.if_partial_or_not_confirmed: Report the negative or mixed result without modifying the method on QASC or any revealed evaluation data.
decision_boundary.musique_policy: Remain STOP_WITHOUT_MUSIQUE_DOWNLOAD from the earlier frozen multi-axis protocol.
